plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jesse Marcel, an Army intelligence officer at Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947, brought home debris from what many say was a crashed craft. According to Michels, Marcel's son, who later became an Air Force flight surgeon, a doctor who looks after pilots, said he played with the material as a boy. Michels describes it as a kind of memory metal that springs back to its shape, and says this fits the father's own account.
